item.description: Apple Silicon is among the most widely used platforms for local LLM inference, yet nearly all inference optimizations are designed and validated on server-class NVIDIA GPUs under batched serving workloads. We evaluate four optimization families: KV-cache pruning, speculative decoding, ported GPU kernels, and post-training quantization. item.title: AgenticEvolve: Evolutionary Program Search with Persistent Language Model Agents that Design and Run Experiments
item.description: Evolutionary program search with large language models keeps the structure of an evolutionary algorithm and uses the model as its variation operator. Typically, the model generates each candidate program in a single request from parent programs and their scores. We present AgenticEvolve, an evolutionary program search framework in which each island is run by a persistent large language model agent. Between evaluations, the agent designs and runs experiments on the candidate program. item.title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence
item.description: Tool-using language model agents rely on environmental facts to decide whether an action is permitted. When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action even though the user request is benign and every returned statement is true. item.title: VecTile: A Low-Cost Flexible Tactile Array for 3-DoF Force Sensing
item.description: Tactile sensing provides robots with contact information difficult to obtain from vision alone. We introduce VecTile, a low-cost, 6 mm thin, flexible tactile array capable of three-axis force sensing. VecTile combines a piezoresistive layer with passive silicone nubs that convert normal and shear forces into distinguishable pressure patterns. item.title: Got a pretrained music transformer to jam with me live, no fine-tuning, just steering the sampling [P]
item.description: I wanted to see how far you can get making a pretrained symbolic music model "listen" to a live player without training it. Turns out pretty far. Setup: I play a MIDI keyboard, the Anticipatory Music Transformer (Thickstun et al., music-medium-800k) plays a second piano. While I play I track my key, the chord I'm holding and my tempo, and add biases to the logits before sampling. item.title: When LLMs Forget What They Believe: Characterizing State Integrity Collapse in Long-Horizon Dialogues
item.description: Large language models can repeat an instruction while failing to keep obeying it.
